facts.claim: Odyssey of the Seas (Royal Caribbean): Entered service 2021; 169,000 GT; 4200 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 347 m length; Quantum Ultra class.
Odyssey of the Seas offers unforgettable onboard activities and delicious dining from around the world. Soak up the sun at the resort-style pool deck on the First Quantum Ultra Class cruise ship.
Discover adventure from Georgetown to Santorini onboard Odyssey of the Seas®.
Odyssey of the Seas is the second Quantum Ultra-class cruise ship and the last of the class operated by Royal Caribbean International.

catalogSpecs.description: A large cruise ship featuring an indoor sports complex and an elevated observation capsule.
